reason: Schleswig is small enough that I just walk, and when it's further I take the bus or get a lift. Honestly the cheaper fix is patching my own flat tyre for a few euros instead of paying per ride.
objection: With only 10 bikes in the whole town I doubt there'd be one near me when I actually need it, so why pay for something I can't count on.
would_change_my_mind: A bike reliably parked near my place and the bus stop, plus a free first ride, for the days I'm running late and miss the bus.
